version: saltmere v4 (v2 set redrawn to size rules: min 5x5, 3x3 clear floor, 1-tile doors, _night window layers)

diag_autotiles.rule:
45-degree corner autotiles (shared by Saltmere v2 and Highfen v3.1).
Mask = which tile CORNERS are inside the terrain: NW=1, NE=2, SE=4, SW=8 (16 frames, frame index = mask).
A set corner owns the 45deg diamond around it (|dx|+|dy|<=8 px); two set corners on one side own that half tile.
=> 1 corner = outer 45deg diagonal cut, 3 corners = inner 45deg diagonal, 2 adjacent = straight edge, 2 opposite = saddle.
A 45deg run alternates diag_out_* / diag_in_* tiles; a straight edge meeting a diag is the straight->diagonal transition.
Sample the shape on the (GH+1)x(GW+1) vertex grid; tile (y,x) frame = V[y,x]*1+V[y,x+1]*2+V[y+1,x+1]*4+V[y+1,x]*8.
diag_autotiles.frame_size: 16x16 (wall: 16x28, the 12px face hangs below into the next row; draw wall rows top->bottom, y-sorted with sprites by row bottom)
diag_autotiles.layering: water (v2_water_*_4f) -> v2_diag_sand_shore -> v2_diag_grass -> v2_diag_sand_path -> v2_diag_cobble -> docks (docks/dock_planks_autotile, edge mask N1|E2|S4|W8) -> wall rows/sprites

v2_gate_side.note: passage runs E-W across rows 48..66 (tile rows 3-4)

wall_pieces.joins: v2_wall_gate_join_w/e.png 16x28 = last wall tile each side of a N/S gate (butts flush into the gate pillars); E/W gate towers sit on the wall run ends
